description: Spin up two in-process stoa-transit instances bound to loopback TCP ports. Have instance A connect to instance B and execute the full RFC 4644 streaming session: MODE STREAM → 203, CHECK <msgid> → 238, TAKETHIS <msgid> + dot-stuffed body → 239. Verify the article lands in instance B's msgid_map and block store. Also exercise the duplicate path: CHECK of an already-held article → 438. This closes gap 1 and gap 2 from the interop audit (wire framing untested at TCP level; no transit-to-transit peering test).
title: test: full MODE STREAM/CHECK/TAKETHIS TCP success path, stoa-to-stoa
